svg.aria-label: Uptime of the bug tracker's website over the 13 weeks from 24 August to 22 November. It was down on Friday 4 September and on Tuesday 13 October, and slow on three other days. Weekends were always OK.

Uptime of the bug tracker's website over the 13 weeks from 24 August to 22 November. It was down on Friday 4 September and on Tuesday 13 October, and slow on three other days. Weekends were always OK.

div.aria-label: The states of the status grid, columns 24 Aug to 5 Oct
The states of the status grid, columns 12 Oct to 16 Nov

ul.li: Each row is a day of the week, and each column is a week, named by its first day.
Each number is in %. A cell is OK at 99.9 or more, Warning from 99 to below 99.9, and Error below 99; a value on a threshold takes the better state. A cell with no state word is OK.
86 cells are OK, 3 are Warning and 2 are Error.
Error: Friday, week of 31 Aug (97.4); Tuesday, week of 12 Oct (98.2).
The worst is 97.4 (Friday, week of 31 Aug).
